items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Like the night they called me to go down to (inaudible), take Coleman's place with Fletcher Henderson, it was the hardest book I ever saw in my life.

ctx.x: three bars ahead. You know, you just try to see that much -- a bar or two ahead when you're playing, you know.

Just don't read note for note. And this what helped me a lot in going through the bands. Like the night they called me to go down to (inaudible), take Coleman's place with Fletcher Henderson, it was the hardest book I ever saw in my life.
